caption:
Quest moves to the front.

Quest Apartment Hotels has signed a three-year extension with the Cronulla Sharks and becomes front-of-jersey major partner for the NRL side from 2027. It stays on with the NRLW team too. It started with the women's jersey and the membership program, and now it's on the front of the men's kit.

Also in the deals: Tyrepower x Port Adelaide, Omoda Jaecoo x Sydney Kings, adidas x Richmond, Callaway Golf x Golf Australia / PGA of Australia and Zoox x Las Vegas Grand Prix.
